stemText: Calculate the work done (w) when 4 mole(s) of an ideal gas expands isothermally and reversibly from 5.0 L to 500.0 L at 400 K. (R = 8.314 J K^-1 mol^-1)

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: State reversible isothermal work formula: w = -2.303 n R T log₁₀(V2 / V1).
Step 2: Substitute n = 4, T = 400 K, V2/V1 = 100, so log₁₀(100) = 2.0.
Step 3: w = -2.303 × 4 × 8.314 × 400 × 2.0 = -61271 J = -61.27 kJ.
Step 4: Conclude that work done is -61.27 kJ.

translations.stemText: 400 K மாறா வெப்பநிலையில் 4 மோல் நல்லியல்பு வாயுவானது 5.0 L இலிருந்து 500.0 L ஆக மீள்முறையில் விரிவடையும் போது செய்யப்பட்ட வேலை (w) என்ன? (R = 8.314 J K^-1 mol^-1)

stemText: An aqueous solution at 298 K has a measured pH of 3. What is the hydroxide ion concentration [OH^-] in this solution? (Ionic product of water Kw = 1.0 × 10^-14)

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: Use the relation pH + pOH = 14 at 298 K: pOH = 14 - pH = 14 - 3 = 11.
Step 2: Calculate [OH^-] using [OH^-] = 10^(-pOH).
Step 3: [OH^-] = 10^-(11) M = 1.0 × 10^-11 M.
Step 4: Conclude that the hydroxide ion concentration is 1.0 × 10^-11 M.
